scientific_integrity: Universal claims are proved analytically by conditional covariance and character decompositions; finite Fourier checks are corroborative and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only one full interior q-ary Hamming shell and the constant-plus-degree-one complex Fourier band are covered.
Sampling is never injective on the whole first Fourier band: its shell equation gives a one-dimensional kernel.
Older association-scheme representation formulas may yield an equivalent result in different notation; absolute priority is not certified.
title: Exact q-ary Hamming-shell Fourier concentration and the arithmetic tightness criterion
